prose: Forbes reports that Amazon is blocking Meta's new Muse AI agent from shopping on amazon.com. The original article could not be retrieved (the fetch returned an error), so this summary is based only on the Forbes headline and its Hacker News discussion; Amazon's stated rationale, the technical mechanism of the block, and Meta's response could not be verified.
